source.license: Apache-2.0 as published for the current Hugging Face checkpoints
source.evidence_scope: official upstream README/model-card claims and evaluation only

observed_source_facts.base_role: 3-second voice clone from reference audio; fine-tuning-capable
observed_source_facts.customvoice_role: preset timbres; 0.6B has no instruction-control field in the released-model table
observed_source_facts.release_availability_note: The current official repository release/download table exposes the 12Hz checkpoints; 25Hz values remain useful as upstream evaluation references but are not treated here as an immediately downloadable production candidate.

interpretation.finding: Do not collapse Qwen3-TTS 0.6B into one benchmark condition. Tokenizer rate and model role materially change the upstream German evaluation, and the currently released 12Hz Base and CustomVoice have different identity/quality tradeoffs.
interpretation.near_term_f2_priority: Benchmark Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base first with a fixed male German reference clip and exact streaming settings; benchmark 12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice separately rather than substituting its preset male voices as an equivalent condition.
interpretation.reason: At source level, the released 12Hz 0.6B Base has substantially lower reported German content WER than the released 12Hz 0.6B CustomVoice (1.089 vs 2.722) and supports reference-audio voice cloning, which maps more directly to Frankenstein's stable male acoustic-identity requirement. This is not local perceptual or runtime evidence.
interpretation.counterhypothesis: On F2's real German conversational corpus, the CustomVoice path may still win naturalness, chunk continuity, TTFA or operational simplicity; upstream WER does not measure the whole voice-organ objective.
interpretation.falsifier: Run both released 12Hz 0.6B variants on identical pinned German F2 text/audio conditions and compare intelligibility/WER, blind naturalness, male identity stability, TTFA/p95, chunk continuity, ExpressionVector compatibility, cancellation and resident footprint.
